# Rose Empire — UK wholesale mattress protectors and pillows

Rose Empire is a Manchester manufacturer-direct B2B supplier of hotel-grade mattress protectors and vacuum-packed goose feather and duck down pillows. Trade buyers: hotels, care homes, retailers, guest houses, and distributors.
